description.value: Rose Cottage is a small bed-and-breakfast guest house in Valemount, BC, set in the Robson Valley surrounded by the Rocky, Monashee, and Cariboo mountain ranges. It offers three rooms each with a private washroom and an included breakfast, and sits within easy reach of Mount Robson Provincial Park, Jasper National Park, and Valemount's well-regarded mountain biking network. The location makes it a plausible overnight stop on a touring or bikepacking route through the central BC interior.
